view_frame: The primary view is TOP (XY plane), showing the handle's footprint. The X-axis represents width (left-right), and the Y-axis represents depth (up-down in the view). The Z-axis represents height (vertical, perpendicular to the view). The 'END SECTION' view shows the circular cross-section in the YZ plane (or XZ depending on orientation, but defined by diameter).

features.placement: The path consists of two straight legs and one semi-circular bend. The bend is centered at (0, 30) with a radius of 20mm, spanning from angle 0 to 180 degrees (counter-clockwise from +X). The right leg extends from (20, 30) to (20, 0). The left leg extends from (-20, 30) to (-20, 0). The section is a circle with diameter 8mm, centered on the path.
features.evidence: Top view shows a U-shape. Text annotation 'Bend centreline R20; straight legs 30 mm'. End section view shows a circle labeled 'diameter 8 mm'.

connections: The straight legs are tangent to the semi-circular bend at the transition points (±20, 30).
edit_rules: Changing the bend radius (R20) moves the legs outward/inward and changes the overall width.
Changing the leg length (30) moves the start/end points of the legs along the Y-axis.
Changing the diameter (8) changes the thickness of the entire handle uniformly.
